en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing several scenes of a town: a central image of a tall‑steepled church partly hidden by trees, surrounding images of residential or institutional buildings among forests, a bridge with cars, and a town overview. At the top center there is a town coat of arms with a cross above wavy lines. Decorative script text in Swedish reads a greeting from Skutskär.
